src/integrations/UniswapV4Integration.so.branch: a hook outside the allowlist reverts HookNotAllowed
src/integrations/UniswapV4Integration.so.reason: The market's PoolKey is fixed at bindMarket, which already refuses any hook outside the allowlist, and the allowlist is empty and immutable (only address(0) passes), so the re-check at receivePosition (REQ-AMM-V4-001) can never fail for a bound market. It stays as the defence the spec requires if an allowlist is ever added.
src/integrations/UniswapV4Integration.so.tests: TEST-331 test_TEST_331_bindRefusesHookedPools (the same check refusing at bindMarket)

src/RiskModule.sol.branch: no First-Loss Reserve recorded for a Hub asset that has coverage Spokes (funded = 0)
src/RiskModule.sol.reason: _coverage returns early when the Hub asset has no coverage Spoke. A Spoke is added to _coverageSpokes only by setDebtReserve, which refuses a zero firstLossReserve and records it in _firstLossReserveOf in the same call, and nothing ever clears that record (removeDebtReserve removes the Spoke and the reserve, not the record). So once a Spoke is listed the record is non-zero, and the zero side of the ternary cannot run. It stays as the defence that keeps coverage() reading 0 rather than calling address(0) if a later version clears the record.
